title: Aylin Gülüm
section: Data science, from analysis to action
text:
Data science, from analysis to action
I am a Data Scientist / ML Engineer with experience building Python- and SQL-based analytics pipelines and machine-learning workflows. My work spans customer segmentation, time-series analytics, data-quality validation, computer vision, fault detection, and LLM/RAG-based decision support. I collaborate with business, research, and client teams to turn questions into clear analyses and actionable findings.

title: Aylin Gülüm
text:
🔬 Projects

Universal Threat Responder

Built a Python threat-triage pipeline combining machine learning, conformal uncertainty, information retrieval, and local LLM reasoning.
Added human review for ambiguous predictions and ML/LLM disagreements, with a locally hosted browser dashboard.
Evaluated the system on 3,960 emails: it automatically handled 76% of cases at 97% accuracy and reduced the threat-miss rate from 4.6% to 0.6% versus the ML-only baseline.

View on GitHub


Railway Semantic Segmentation (RailSem19)

Compared pretrained HRNet and LangSAM zero-shot segmentation for vegetation detection in railway imagery, achieving 0.62 average IoU.
Explored a monitoring pipeline combining image analysis, GPS metadata, and severity-based maintenance alerts.

View on GitHub


SECOM Equipment Fault Detection

Prepared high-dimensional semiconductor sensor data, selected features, and reduced dimensionality.
Built and compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and SVM models with hyperparameter optimization, considering class imbalance and generalization.

View on GitHub


Forest Segmentation (M.Sc. Thesis)
Evaluating the Impact of Data Augmentation on Forest Segmentation Using Aerial Imagery and LiDAR Data
View on GitHub
